title: Contract Payment Record Schedule for Restart Down Payments, Deficiency Balance Accounts
content:
**Schedule.** The restart percent of an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts (the percentage of the balance at which its restart down payment is figured) takes account of the payment record of the contract that produced the account, read from the borrower's Retail Installment Contracts. The restart contract payments are the payments of the installment type posted on that contract's ledger, less the payments returned on that contract's ledger. 24 or more restart contract payments lower the restart percent by 1.0 point, at least 12 but fewer than 24 lower it by 0.5 points, and fewer lower it by no points.

## Schedule table

| Restart contract payments | Restart percent lowered by |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 1.0 point |
| 12 to 23 | 0.5 points |
| 0 to 11 | No points |

## How the count is formed

- Only the contract recorded on the Deficiency Balance Account as the liquidated contract is read; another contract of the same borrower is not.
- Payments posted on the contract count only when their payment type is installment; payoff, reinstatement, redemption, insurance-settlement and sale-proceeds payments do not add to the count.
- Every payment returned on the contract is taken off the count, whatever payment it returned.

## Worked counts (hypothetical)

| Installment payments posted | Payments returned | Restart contract payments | Lowered by |
|---|---|---|---|
| 26 | 2 | 24 | 1.0 point |
| 26 | 3 | 23 | 0.5 points |
| 13 | 1 | 12 | 0.5 points |
| 13 | 2 | 11 | No points |
